setupPolicy.exception: Visible public recovery/reset may use its prescribed recoveryReset implementation; diagnostic probes may only re-deliver unchanged real observations as negative tests, never award success.

supplementalGeometryDesign.speedBoundMeaning: New M0 observation/CCD design bound, not a velocity clamp or measured guarantee. Exceeding it is a retained out-of-contract failure; never drop the event, teleport, or loosen the limit to claim PASS. T34 must qualify all crossings including the whole compound geometry at this bound.
supplementalGeometryDesign.fullCrossing: Track each submitted item from actual inside-chamber provenance through the chute. Freeze first real transition of maximum world Y over all child-shape support points to <= planeY after submit; an enter, COM crossing or side entry is insufficient. Numeric uncertainty is recorded and cannot manufacture crossing.
supplementalGeometryDesign.channelClearancePopulation: Clearance checks count every live inventory item whose full geometry intersects the channel, including unshipped non-snapshot items. The door, structural chute walls and declared static fixture solids are not inventory items; their independent collision/sweep safety must still be verified, not hidden by this classification.

commonBudgets.clock: fixed active ticks; wall limits are independent runner-failure limits, never extra gameplay time

executionPolicy.positiveEvidence: Real public input, unmodified physical observations and actual end-to-end ledger from one identified run. No test setup, static arithmetic or diagnostic injected copy counts as a successful shipment.
executionPolicy.trialCounting: Every variant/calibration/trial has its own runId and reaches real result/retry completion/teardown. Variants may increase actual rounds above 20; never count setup, repeated assertions or diagnostic copies as extra rounds. A failed trigger is not PASS, and its cleanup is not positive business evidence.
executionPolicy.normalProfileIsolation: Modified geometry/mass/motor/recovery-allocation profiles are labelled abnormal and cannot replace any of the five unmodified normal-layout BIZ01 runs.
executionPolicy.requiredRaw: Retain all commands including rejection acks, observations and contact/geometry provenance, before/after counters, fixture/setup differences, attempts/failures and actual terminal; do not relabel old PASS.
executionPolicy.resolveProfile: Before scene creation merge the base configuration/layout with explicitly listed setup differences, validate it, compute a canonical resolved setup/config hash and load the declared effectiveConfigVersion. Variants with explicit configVersion override that value. Never mutate it in a running round.
